name: node_projection_day_reader
descriptor:
  responsibility: project one day of ledger events into the day rollup
io_operations:
  - operation_type: database_read
    target: ledger_events
unread_outcome:
  returns: a typed refusal when the day cannot be read
  test: tests/unit/test_projection_day_reader.py::test_projection_refuses_unreadable_day
